contact_sources.quote: Gabriele Quargnali, CAIA Investment Manager Gabriele works as an Investment Manager at AQUIS Capital, covering hedge fund solutions and managing a global multi-strategy Fund of Hedge Funds portfolio, being a member of the Investment Committee. He joined AQUIS Capital in May 2021 as an Investment Analyst focusing on the Hedge Fund Research. Prior to this experience, he worked as an ESG project analyst in the Global Investment Communications department at Vontobel Asset Management. He started his career in the Global Asset and Wealth Management Research Department at PwC Luxembourg. Gabriele holds a Master of Science in Finance from HEC Lausanne, a Bachelor of Science in Industrial Engineering from the University of Trieste and is a CAIA Charterholder.

Gabriele Quargnali, CAIA Investment Manager Gabriele arbeitet als Investment Manager bei AQUIS Capital, wo er für Hedgefonds-Lösungen zuständig ist, ein globales Multi-Strategie-Fund-of-Hedge-Funds-Portfolio verwaltet und Mitglied des Investment Committees ist. Er kam im Mai 2021 als Investment Analyst mit Schwerpunkt auf Hedgefonds-Research zu AQUIS Capital. Vor dieser Tätigkeit arbeitete er als ESG Project Analyst in der Abteilung Global Investment Communications bei Vontobel Asset Management. Er begann seine Karriere im Global Asset and Wealth Management Research Department bei PwC Luxemburg. Gabriele verfügt über einen Master of Science in Finance der HEC Lausanne, einen Bachelor of Science in Industrial Engineering (Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen) der Universität Triest und ist CAIA Charterholder.
